name: Virag Human-Authored Instagram Design Systems
sourceBasis: Design principles extracted from the user's supplied Pinterest Instagram-design references. Do not copy individual artwork, brands, compositions or text.
principles: A fresh design changes the entire visual system: grid, crop, type architecture, graphic devices, information structure, product placement, palette and texture.
The selected product remains exact; reference designs influence principles only.
Every output is one standalone image, never a multi-output collage, contact sheet or preview grid.
Auto Fresh assigns a different design system to each output and does not repeat a family until all compatible families are used.
Choose category-relevant systems and reject decorative style that does not communicate the product.

PRODUCT PIXEL LOCK: In Pixel-Locked Composite mode, isolate and reuse the uploaded product as an unchanged source cutout. Never redraw, regenerate, relight, recolor, inpaint, stretch, squash, bend, morph, perspective-warp or reconstruct it. Use only aspect-ratio-locked uniform scale and translation; keep the full silhouette by default. Build the design around it and add shadows, reflections or overlaps on separate outside layers. Reject any change to silhouette, proportions, lid/cap, shoulders, base, label bounds, logo, colors or printed text.
HUMAN STUDIO: Every system must be manually art-directed in appearance—purposeful asymmetry, optical spacing, restrained effects, believable materials and real 2D typesetting.

autoRouter.selection: Assign systems in output order. Begin with the family best suited to the product/category, then rotate through compatible unused families.
autoRouter.rejection: Reject the batch if any two outputs share the same grid skeleton, hero placement, dominant type arrangement, callout style or background system.

designSystems.label: Editorial Cutout
designSystems.summary: Magazine-style asymmetric composition with dramatic cropped photography, subject windows and small precision details.
designSystems.layout: Use an asymmetric two-column or offset-strip grid, one dominant crop, narrow text columns, disciplined margins and generous breathing room.
designSystems.product: Use the pixel-locked uploaded product cutout without redrawing or warping it. Integrate the exact product as a purposeful crop or anchored cutout, never a centered catalogue packshot.
designSystems.typography: Large editorial display word paired with compact sans-serif microcopy, issue-style numbers, rules and vertical labels.
designSystems.graphics: Use one or two crop windows, fine rules, page markers, restrained symbols and subtle texture.
designSystems.color: Mostly neutral or brand-light base with one confident accent color.
designSystems.information: One short hook, two compact supporting facts and a small footer.
designSystems.avoid: Magazine-cover imitation, random barcodes, excessive microcopy or unrelated fashion styling. Also avoid generic glossy CGI, default neon glow, random particles, perfect plastic surfaces, fake bokeh, impossible reflections, centered-pedestal symmetry and generated-looking typography.
designSystems.humanFinish: Use optical rather than mathematical spacing, one dominant idea, restrained depth, believable material detail and a clean separately typeset information layer. Remove any generic AI-render signature.

designSystems.label: Benefit Infographic
designSystems.summary: Clean product-led information design with visible benefit cards, icons, callouts and mobile hierarchy.
designSystems.layout: Place product off-center with a dedicated information column or curved callout field occupying at least one-third of the canvas.
designSystems.product: Use the pixel-locked uploaded product cutout without redrawing or warping it. Keep product large enough to read but leave clear space for two to four fact modules.
designSystems.typography: Bold clean sans headline, medium-weight fact titles and highly readable small support text.
designSystems.graphics: Use icon containers, leader lines, numbered facts, pills, progress/data bars, dividers and soft panels.
designSystems.color: Use the product palette plus one neutral background and one contrast accent.
designSystems.information: Exact product name plus two to four supplied or label-derived facts; CTA only when supplied.
designSystems.avoid: Tiny fact text, fake statistics, clinical clutter or an ecommerce image with floating icons. Also avoid generic glossy CGI, default neon glow, random particles, perfect plastic surfaces, fake bokeh, impossible reflections, centered-pedestal symmetry and generated-looking typography.
designSystems.humanFinish: Use optical rather than mathematical spacing, one dominant idea, restrained depth, believable material detail and a clean separately typeset information layer. Remove any generic AI-render signature.

designSystems.label: Bold Type Integration
designSystems.summary: Oversized typography becomes an architectural design element that interacts with the product.
designSystems.layout: Use one large word or short phrase across 30–50% of the canvas, with the product overlapping, passing behind or cutting through letterforms.
designSystems.product: Use the pixel-locked uploaded product cutout without redrawing or warping it. Anchor the product asymmetrically and preserve its full identity while creating depth against the type.
designSystems.typography: One real condensed or geometric display family plus restrained sans support; maximum one dominant phrase.
designSystems.graphics: Use masks, outlines, underlines, directional bars and controlled shadow layers.
designSystems.color: High-contrast brand color blocking with no generic neon gradient.
designSystems.information: Dominant product/brand phrase plus one or two supporting facts.
designSystems.avoid: Movie-title poster stacking, unreadable decorative type, giant slogan with no information or fake lettering. Also avoid generic glossy CGI, default neon glow, random particles, perfect plastic surfaces, fake bokeh, impossible reflections, centered-pedestal symmetry and generated-looking typography.
designSystems.humanFinish: Use optical rather than mathematical spacing, one dominant idea, restrained depth, believable material detail and a clean separately typeset information layer. Remove any generic AI-render signature.

designSystems.label: Minimal Spatial
designSystems.summary: Premium negative-space design with precise alignment, subtle material depth and a few confident details.
designSystems.layout: Use 55–70% controlled negative space, an offset product anchor and a small modular information cluster.
designSystems.product: Use the pixel-locked uploaded product cutout without redrawing or warping it. Use one deliberate crop or floating-but-believable placement with accurate contact/light logic.
designSystems.typography: Refined serif or modern grotesk with generous tracking and short copy.
designSystems.graphics: Use one geometric frame, one line system and one subtle texture or shadow plane.
designSystems.color: Warm white, soft neutral or pale brand tint with one deep accent.
designSystems.information: Product name, one exact fact and a restrained supplied CTA or footer.
designSystems.avoid: Empty studio packshot, excessive luxury clichés, random spheres or design that becomes only blank space. Also avoid generic glossy CGI, default neon glow, random particles, perfect plastic surfaces, fake bokeh, impossible reflections, centered-pedestal symmetry and generated-looking typography.
designSystems.humanFinish: Use optical rather than mathematical spacing, one dominant idea, restrained depth, believable material detail and a clean separately typeset information layer. Remove any generic AI-render signature.

designSystems.label: Brand Pattern System
designSystems.summary: Product-specific labels, strips, repeating words and modular brand marks create an energetic feed identity.
designSystems.layout: Build diagonal or horizontal movement with repeated strips while reserving one clean product and copy zone.
designSystems.product: Use the pixel-locked uploaded product cutout without redrawing or warping it. Weave the exact product through the pattern without duplicating the container as background.
designSystems.typography: Repeated real brand/product wording as secondary texture plus one clear primary information block.
designSystems.graphics: Use tape strips, labels, stamps, arrows, cropped brand shapes and controlled repetition.
designSystems.color: Use two or three brand-derived colors with strong rhythm.
designSystems.information: One clear hook and two exact facts in labelled modules.
designSystems.avoid: Unreadable wallpaper text, duplicated product packs, chaotic sticker bombing or fake logos. Also avoid generic glossy CGI, default neon glow, random particles, perfect plastic surfaces, fake bokeh, impossible reflections, centered-pedestal symmetry and generated-looking typography.
designSystems.humanFinish: Use optical rather than mathematical spacing, one dominant idea, restrained depth, believable material detail and a clean separately typeset information layer. Remove any generic AI-render signature.

designSystems.label: Miniature Brand World
designSystems.summary: A believable small brand world turns product form or category meaning into a narrative environment.
designSystems.layout: Use a clear foreground story, dominant product anchor and compact upper/lower social information zones.
designSystems.product: Use the pixel-locked uploaded product cutout without redrawing or warping it. Preserve the exact product and use scale intentionally as architecture, kiosk, vehicle or environment only when the metaphor fits.
designSystems.typography: Friendly bold display or clean brand sans with compact labels.
designSystems.graphics: Use route lines, signs, small info cards and environmental brand details.
designSystems.color: Category-relevant daylight palette with natural material contrast.
designSystems.information: Short concept hook plus two factual product callouts.
designSystems.avoid: Random tiny people, generic toy world, impossible scale/contact or a raw CGI scene without social layout. Also avoid generic glossy CGI, default neon glow, random particles, perfect plastic surfaces, fake bokeh, impossible reflections, centered-pedestal symmetry and generated-looking typography.

designSystems.label: Contextual Story
designSystems.summary: A bright real-world or seasonal micro-story connects the product to a human situation or occasion.
designSystems.layout: Use an action-led diagonal or environmental frame, with product and person/context balanced by a clean information zone.
designSystems.product: Use the pixel-locked uploaded product cutout without redrawing or warping it. Show believable use, placement or interaction without changing packaging or forcing category clichés.
designSystems.typography: Warm expressive headline paired with clean factual sans text.
designSystems.graphics: Use hand-drawn accents, contextual icons, soft shapes, frames and a branded footer.
designSystems.color: Bright natural daylight and optimistic brand-derived colors.
designSystems.information: One contextual hook plus one to three exact product facts.
designSystems.avoid: Generic festival symbols, random lifestyle models, unsupported occasion copy or cinematic scene with no designed content. Also avoid generic glossy CGI, default neon glow, random particles, perfect plastic surfaces, fake bokeh, impossible reflections, centered-pedestal symmetry and generated-looking typography.

designSystems.label: Premium Natural
designSystems.summary: Ingredient and material storytelling with tactile surfaces, organic forms and elegant benefit structure.
designSystems.layout: Use product on one side, ingredient/material story on the other, with a strong text column and benefit icons.
designSystems.product: Use the pixel-locked uploaded product cutout without redrawing or warping it. Keep product exact and grounded in a believable tactile set; ingredients appear only when supplied or visibly relevant.
designSystems.typography: High-contrast serif headline with a neutral sans information system.
designSystems.graphics: Use organic masks, leaf/ingredient silhouettes, soft circles, fine dividers and benefit badges.
designSystems.color: Muted botanical, mineral or warm neutral palette derived from the product.
designSystems.information: Product name plus two to four exact feature/benefit statements.
designSystems.avoid: Generic leaves, silk, water splash or flowers used without product relevance. Also avoid generic glossy CGI, default neon glow, random particles, perfect plastic surfaces, fake bokeh, impossible reflections, centered-pedestal symmetry and generated-looking typography.

designSystems.label: Energetic Commercial
designSystems.summary: Bold brand-color campaign with dynamic scale, directional movement and high-impact retail readability.
designSystems.layout: Use diagonal movement, large asymmetrical product scale and compact high-contrast information blocks.
designSystems.product: Use the pixel-locked uploaded product cutout without redrawing or warping it. Make the exact product energetic through crop, tilt or motion cues without deforming it.
designSystems.typography: Bold condensed display plus clean supporting sans; strong scale contrast.
designSystems.graphics: Use bursts, speed lines, blocks, arrows, cut shapes and controlled texture.
designSystems.color: Two strong brand colors plus one contrasting accent.
designSystems.information: One concise hook, two exact facts and supplied CTA.
designSystems.avoid: Generic particles, explosive splash as the whole idea, sports clichés or loud design without hierarchy. designSystems.label: Data & Callout Story
designSystems.summary: Structured feature explanation uses numbers, comparison bars and diagram-like callouts as the main visual hook.
designSystems.layout: Use a product anchor with an organized radial, column or stepped information map.
designSystems.product: Use the pixel-locked uploaded product cutout without redrawing or warping it. Preserve product accurately and connect facts with clean leader lines without covering the label.
designSystems.typography: Tabular or grotesk sans with strong numeric hierarchy and short labels.
designSystems.graphics: Use diagrams, data bars, numbered nodes, rings, check modules and precise dividers.
designSystems.color: Clean high-contrast palette with one data accent and ample neutral space.
designSystems.information: Three to six exact supplied metrics or facts; omit any unavailable field rather than inventing it.
designSystems.avoid: Fake dashboards, meaningless percentages, tiny technical clutter or sci-fi HUD styling. Also avoid generic glossy CGI, default neon glow, random particles, perfect plastic surfaces, fake bokeh, impossible reflections, centered-pedestal symmetry and generated-looking typography.

designSystems.product: Use the pixel-locked uploaded product cutout without redrawing or warping it. Place the exact product as a clean cutout integrated between layers.
designSystems.typography: Characterful real display face paired with a plain readable sans; use imperfect-but-controlled alignment.
designSystems.graphics: Use torn edges, paper grain, marker lines, stamps, halftone and cut shapes.
designSystems.color: Limited two-to-four color print palette derived from the brand.
designSystems.information: One expressive hook and two compact fact labels.
designSystems.avoid: A collage/contact sheet, random scrapbook objects, illegible handwriting or distressed product packaging. designSystems.layout: Use one dominant metaphor scene balanced by a clean branded information column or lower module field.
designSystems.product: Use the pixel-locked uploaded product cutout without redrawing or warping it. Preserve the exact product and integrate it into the metaphor without morphing the container or duplicating the package.

designSystems.information: One concept hook plus two exact product facts.

humanAuthenticity.rule: Use one dominant communication idea and one supporting graphic device. Prefer natural or practical light, credible surfaces, limited palettes, optical alignment and small tactile imperfections.
